---
title: "Table sources"
---

The Wikipedia pages below already store their data in a clean HTML table. We can scrape these directly with `pandas.read_html()` without any text parsing.

* [List of social networking services](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_social_networking_services): name, type, focus/audience.
* [List of defunct social networking services](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_defunct_social_networking_services): name, type, focus. Covers the platforms this generation grew up on and lost (Myspace, Vine, AIM).
* [List of recessions in the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_recessions_in_the_United_States): name, period, duration, peak unemployment, GDP decline. Spans the dot-com bust and the 2008 financial crisis.
* [List of cryptocurrencies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies): year introduced, currency, founder, consensus mechanism.
* [List of countries by minimum wage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_minimum_wage): country, nominal and PPP (purchasing power parity) annual/hourly wage, percent of GDP per capita.
* [List of Disney Channel original films](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Disney_Channel_Original_Movies): year, film, premiere date, US viewership in millions.
* [History of the web browser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_web_browser): a "Historical web browsers" table with Browser, Years, and per-OS support columns.
* [List of search engines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_search_engines): a "Defunct or acquired" table with Name, Backend ownership, and Demise columns. Covers the Ask Jeeves, AltaVista, and Lycos era.
* [Comparison of cross-platform instant messaging clients](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comparison_of_cross-platform_instant_messaging_clients): Developer, Initial release, Platform, Latest release, license, monthly active users.
* [iPod, "Models and features" table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPod#Models_and_features): Model, Generation, Capacity, Connection, Original release date, Minimum OS to sync, Rated battery life.
* [Comparison of online dating services](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comparison_of_online_dating_services): Name, Owner, Registered users, Free, All features free, Hetero/polyamorous connections, Free messaging, STD-notification.
* [List of most popular social platforms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most_popular_social_platforms): Name, Company, Country, Launched, Monthly active users, Other metrics.
